name: mindchain
description: MindChain — blockchain-based mental health monitoring and patient–therapist management

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix blockchain && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix e2e
scripts.deploy: npm run compile --prefix blockchain && npm run deploy:local --prefix blockchain
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:server && npm run build --prefix client && npm run test:e2e
